messages:
dana: Heads-up — Acme Health just escalated. They want a Private (VPC) pilot + KMS + HIPAA-ready audit by 4/28. They offered a pilot contract if we can deliver a minimal Private bundle. Can we shift mid-quarter priorities?
sam: Who's the exec contact and how firm is the deadline? :thinking:
dana: Exec is Lisa H (CISO). Requirements: AWS KMS integration (HSM optional), exportable audit logs, and the ability to stand up 2 dedicated pools at ~100 qps sustained. Pilot auto-renew if successful.
kevin: KMS + audit logging is straightforward-ish, but Private control-plane work + packaging is the big lift. Not in current sprint unless we cut scope.
alisha: This effectively pulls our "Private GA" forward. Current OKR wording is "Private GA" with canary automation + console polish.
ben: Proposal: scope a "Private Pilot v0" bundle and deprioritize canary automation + console polish for the pilot. Minimal deliverables: KMS integration, basic audit exports, VPC docs, manual rollout runbook, short pilot SLA. 2-week focused effort + follow-ups.
dana: Proposed scope (copyable):
```
- Scope: Private Pilot v0
  - AWS KMS integration for encryption-at-rest + key rotation
  - Audit logs exported to customer S3 (basic schema)
  - Manual rollout + runbook
  - SLA: pilot-level (best-effort/99.5 target)
  - Exclude: automated canary rollouts, full console UX polish, extended observability retention
```
sam: OK — what exact OKR change do we make? Suggest change Q2 OKR from "Ship Private GA" to "Ship Private Pilot" and reduce weight accordingly. Any objections?
kevin: I can free up 2 engineers from quant for ~3 sprints, but quant team will push back — perf work will slip. Need to be explicit about tradeoffs.
alisha: Ops/Sec will require +1 SRE to own audit + KMS smoke tests. That increases support load during pilot.
dana: Decision path: PM + Eng leads approve scope cut, GTM + Legal sign pilot MOU. If approved we'll update OKRs this week and notify execs.
carmen: From Sales: Lisa's team expects credits or pilot pricing concessions. Are we okay with that? :eyes: 
ben: Fine if pilot MOU limits liability and SLA. Legal to confirm.
oncall-bot: Reminder — security patch window scheduled 48h after pilot onboarding; coordinate timelines.
dana: Next steps: 1) Eng leads confirm resource shift by EOD Thu; 2) Legal & Sales draft pilot MOU by Fri; 3) Update Q2 OKR doc and flag in all-hands.
sam: I'm okay delaying some quant perf targets to Q4. Sam + Kevin will post an updated capacity plan by EOD Thu.
kevin: We can deliver the minimal KMS + logs in 3 sprints if console work is cut. I'll post a sprint-by-sprint breakdown in #eng-platform.
alisha: Also adding monitoring for billing anomalies during pilot — don't want surprise charges for the customer.
dana: Thanks all. I'll loop in GTM/Legal now and update the OKR doc if we get approvals. If anyone has blockers speak now. :pray:
